messages.subject: Stratton - first annual price review coming up
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Unrelated to Aquilo, but the first annual CPI price review under the Stratton Energy supply agreement is due next month. Can someone confirm the indexation mechanism and the notice we need to give Stratton? Want to make sure we don't miss the window.

Rebecca
